scope: Blender and ParaView provider workers; not five-provider console/UI integration

runs.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src FUSION_LIVE_BLENDER=<blender>/blender-local python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/unit -p 'test_blender_live.py' -v
nativeAssertions: Cube dimension edits retain native PID and object identities; six faces and twelve triangles; size-four X bounds equal [-2, 2].
Missing STL apply fails, reports rolledBack, and subsequent geometry response equals the previous response exactly.
PNG decodes at 640x480 with nonuniform pixels.
Native .blend save and JSON receipt succeed; geometry is unchanged by save; further edits use the same PID.
After closing the live worker, a fresh Blender process opens the saved .blend with auto-execution disabled and compares evaluated geometry digest against embedded metadata.
Seven existing mesh-workshop documents execute in one persistent PID: weightedNormals, twist, bend, weld, voxelUnion, shrinkwrap, plyImport. Batch axes are reduced to their final single value.
Terminating the known Python owner with SIGTERM causes its installed Blender worker to exit; PID birth-time checks guard the assertion and cleanup.

runs.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src FUSION_LIVE_PARAVIEW=<paraview>/ParaView-5.13.3-MPI-Linux-Python3.10-x86_64 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/unit -p 'test_paraview_live.py' -v
nativeAssertions: Sphere radius edits retain native PID and proxy identities; tessellation coordinates scale by two.
Invalid radius leaves geometry unchanged; missing-field native calculator failure reports rolledBack and restores the previous geometry response exactly.
PNG decodes at 640x480 with nonuniform pixels and camera readback checks.
Native .pvsm save succeeds; geometry is unchanged by save; further edits use the same PID.
After closing the live worker, a fresh pvpython process loads the saved .pvsm, updates the source, and compares evaluated geometry digest against its receipt.
Composite output contains two uniquely identified leaves with valid local triangle indices; line output exposes edges.
PLY-backed .pvsm receipt lists the absolute source path, datasetsCopied=false and portable=false.
Terminating the known Python owner with SIGTERM causes its installed ParaView worker to exit; PID birth-time checks guard the assertion and cleanup.

hostAssertions: Host imports do not load bpy or paraview.simple.
Compatible graph edits reuse handles; failed native mutation rebuilds previous state; failed restoration marks state uncertain and blocks reads/edits.
Unsupported commands, batch states, nonfinite JSON, incorrect save extensions and receipt overwrites are rejected.
Startup exit and timeout reap the owned process; dispatch allocation cancellation interrupts a pending wait and reaps a sleeping Python subprocess within three seconds.
Owner liveness rejects zombie processes and recycled PIDs.

artifactRetention.reason: Native tests use TemporaryDirectory; screenshots, native scenes, receipts, worker runtime snapshots and logs were cleaned on exit. Original absolute temporary paths were not retained.
artifactRetention.testOutputProvenance: Final successful tool outputs in this task, execution session IDs recorded above; excerpts transcribed into this summary, not recreated by a rerun.
artifactRetention.durableIntegrationEvidence: To be produced separately by tools/qualify_console_integration.py; this summary does not claim that integration run passed.

limitations: Serial installed-runtime qualification only; no MPI, remote ParaView, concurrent GPU, or exhaustive declaration coverage.

Blender save itself verifies native library parse and object/material membership. ParaView save itself verifies state XML and proxy membership. Neither save command independently replays geometry on every call.

Independent-process reopen tests cover a Blender cube and a ParaView sphere. They reuse the same trusted tessellation/digest helper, not an independent geometry implementation, and do not establish arbitrary-scene or external-dataset replay fidelity.

ParaView .pvsm references external datasets; no datasets are copied. Receipt dependency lists cover declared file/files options, not exhaustive case-directory or transitive sidecar closure. The PLY-backed save was checked for dependency metadata, not independently reopened in this suite.

Cancellation timing was tested with a sleeping host Python subprocess. Native owner-death tests terminated idle owners after status, not workers blocked in long native calls; watchdog forced-exit behavior during blocked native calls was not separately qualified.
Images were checked by decoding, dimensions, pixel variation and applicable camera readback; no visual-quality or engineering-accuracy review is claimed.
Face identifiers are revision-scoped. Live mode requires one scene and one resolved geometry state; authored batch publications are not executed.
No retained raw artifacts can be independently re-inspected from these runs; rerun the exact commands or use the separate durable console integration qualification.
